cohort: The study participants consisted of women with preeclamptic and normal pregnancies from cohorts collected in the Netherlands, Finland, and Norway.
finding: Serum FH concentrations were lower in preeclamptic pregnancies compared to control pregnancies, particularly in early-onset PE cases, while levels of anti-C1q and anti-FH autoantibodies did not differ between the groups.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy when preeclampsia manifests (generally second half of pregnancy).
